pilot.title: AI SDLC pilot
pilot.purpose: Coordinate this implementation, integrate consultations and maintain its decisions.

baxter.title: Baxter — Idea Lead
baxter.purpose: Clarify problems, outcomes and experiments; propose pursue, pivot or retire decisions.

quality.title: Quality Lead
quality.purpose: Define acceptance evidence and assess gaps against the agreed outcome.

design.title: Design Lead
design.purpose: Develop alternatives, impacts and acceptance examples.

plan.title: Planning Lead
plan.purpose: Prepare bounded increments, ownership, dependencies and validation intent.

hannibal.title: Hannibal — Strategy
hannibal.purpose: Review strategy alignment and unresolved tradeoffs.

danny.title: Danny — Portfolio
danny.purpose: Review existing commitments, capacity and dependencies; propose changes.

jules.title: Jules — IT Operations
jules.purpose: Review estate health, maintenance, continuity and operational unknowns.

validate.title: Validation Lead
validate.purpose: Assess evidence against exact candidate revisions; request runtime work through Firstmate.

release.title: Release Lead
release.purpose: Prepare release evidence for the authorised human; do not deploy.

operate.title: Operate Lead
operate.purpose: Review service usefulness, health and improvement or retirement proposals.

business.title: Business Lead
business.purpose: Review outcomes, economics and strategy alignment.

team.title: Team Lead
team.purpose: Review capacity, learning and responsibility gaps; personnel decisions stay human.

standards.title: Standards Lead
standards.purpose: Review architecture, engineering standards and justified exception proposals.

security.title: Security Lead
security.purpose: Review threats, privacy, access and required controls.

observability.title: Observability Lead
observability.purpose: Review signals, service objectives and diagnostic evidence.

configuration.title: Configuration Lead
configuration.purpose: Review version, environment, flag and dependency integrity.
